conventions.id_policy: Namespaced stable IDs; display names are not identity. Method IDs include their declaring class to distinguish same-name methods.
conventions.edge_identity: One links_meta entry per ordered endpoint pair. The current renderer collapses parallel edges; richer multiple-evidence relationships should be recorded in one entry until multigraph support exists.

direction.delivers: event → broker or broker → receiving callable

conventions.source_locations: Illustrative locations in a fictional repository, not links to files that exist here. Numeric line ranges must not be interpreted as measured source analysis.
conventions.metrics: Targets and field names are illustrative; absent measurements are null rather than invented observations.
conventions.events: Shared broker adjacency does not imply all publishers reach all consumers. Use focused scenario paths and subscription semantics, not unrestricted reachability, to explain a specific event flow.
conventions.paths: Listed paths explain focused scenarios. Unlisted relationship-support paths expose otherwise-uncovered edges without cluttering the sidebar. Paths are not traces and do not assert execution order across independent branches.
conventions.current_loader: Extra tuple fields, links_meta entries, and path metadata survive source merging. Top-level _meta and $schema are ignored by the current loader. Prepared nodes and links currently discard custom metadata.
conventions.runtime_support: No metadata inspector, automatic grouping, projections, or saved-view interpreter is implemented by this dataset.
conventions.implied_links: The configuration prerequisite is deliberately repeated in links_implied so it accompanies order placement even when a selected scenario omits its configuration edge. This is a dependency/context rule, not an extra runtime call.
